# Eclipse Theia

> Eclipse Theia is an open-source project hosted by the Eclipse Foundation. It consists of the Theia Platform, a framework for building custom IDEs and tools that run in the browser and on the desktop; Theia AI, an open-source, vendor-neutral AI harness platform that is part of the Theia Platform; and the Theia IDE, an AI-native, open-source IDE for desktop and browser built on both.

Key facts:

- The Theia Platform is not a fork of VS Code. It is a modular framework written in TypeScript that reuses the Monaco editor and supports VS Code extensions from Open VSX.
- Theia AI provides the building blocks for AI-native tools: a ready-to-use default harness, customizable agents, chat, tool calling, prompt management, and flexible LLM integration. It supports MCP, Agent Skills and Agent Plugins.
- The Theia IDE works with any LLM provider or local model (bring your own key, no vendor lock-in), and integrates Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.
- Products built on Theia include the Arduino IDE 2.x, Texas Instruments' Code Composer Studio, AMD's Vitis Unified IDE, STMicroelectronics' STM32CubeMX2 and Samsung's Sokatoa.
- License: EPL-2.0 (Theia Platform), MIT (Theia IDE).

## Overview

- [Theia IDE](https://theia-ide.org/): The AI-native, open-source Theia IDE, with downloads and an online version
- [Theia Platform](https://theia-ide.org/theia-platform/): The framework for building custom IDEs and tools, with selected adopters
- [Theia AI](https://theia-ide.org/theia-ai/): The vendor-neutral AI harness platform for AI-native tools and IDEs
- [FAQ](https://theia-ide.org/docs/faq/): How Theia relates to the Eclipse IDE, VS Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code; licensing; adopters
- [Project Goals](https://theia-ide.org/docs/project_goals/): Why Theia exists and how it is governed

## Using the Theia IDE

- [Getting Started](https://theia-ide.org/docs/user_getting_started/): Installing and using the Theia IDE
- [Using AI Features](https://theia-ide.org/docs/user_ai/): AI chat, agents, LLM providers, local models, MCP, Agent Skills, Claude Code and GitHub Copilot in the Theia IDE
- [Theia Coder](https://theia-ide.org/docs/theia_coder/): The AI coding agent of the Theia IDE
- [Installing VS Code Extensions](https://theia-ide.org/docs/user_install_vscode_extensions/): Using VS Code extensions from Open VSX
- [Download](https://theia-ide.org/docs/blueprint_download/): Desktop downloads for Windows, macOS and Linux

## Building on the Theia Platform

- [Build your own IDE/Tool](https://theia-ide.org/docs/composing_applications/): How to create a custom Theia-based application
- [Architecture Overview](https://theia-ide.org/docs/architecture/): Frontend/backend architecture, browser and Electron deployment
- [Extensions and Plugins](https://theia-ide.org/docs/extensions/): Theia extensions versus VS Code extensions
- [Authoring Theia Extensions](https://theia-ide.org/docs/authoring_extensions/): Writing a first Theia extension
- [Services and Contributions](https://theia-ide.org/docs/services_and_contributions/): The dependency-injection based extension model
- [Building AI features with Theia AI](https://theia-ide.org/docs/theia_ai/): Creating custom agents, tools and AI-powered features
- [Theia API Documentation](https://theia-ide.org/docs/theia_api_documentation/): Generated API reference
